title: Shallot project manifest
description: The committed source of truth for a shallot project's scene + plugin enablement (shallot.json). Read identically by every boot host.

file.description: Path to the recipe check, relative to the manifest.

claim.description: The defect this recipe check catches.

class.description: What running the recipe check costs; defaults from tier.

tier.description: Which runner and cadence owns the recipe check; also supplies class and budget defaults.

premises.description: External things that must exist for the recipe check to run; defaults to none.

budget.description: The recipe check's wall-clock budget in milliseconds; defaults from tier.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete + validation.

kind.description: Examples only: which table of the generated examples index this project belongs to. Ignored by dev, build and run.

description.description: One line naming the problem the project answers; the examples index prints it.

problem.description: Examples only: the user's problem in their own words; the examples index prints it in place of description. Ignored by dev, build and run.

scene.description: Path to the project's scene file, relative to the manifest (e.g. "scenes/main.scene").

capacity.description: Fixed entity capacity for the session (a build-time invariant). Omit for the engine default (65536).

pixelRatio.description: Render pixel ratio. Use a positive number or "auto"; omit for the engine default.

assets.description: Examples only: names of assets.json entries this project loads; `bun run assets` links each under this project's public/ directory. Ignored by dev, build and run.

identifier.description: The bundle identifier for native builds (mac CFBundleIdentifier). Omit for the default com.shallot.<basename>.

plugins.description: Plugin enablement. An engine plugin is enabled by name with true/false; a local/external plugin is a module specifier whose default export is the Plugin.

oneOf.description: An engine plugin: true enables it, false disables a default.
A local/external plugin: a module specifier (relative path like "./src/x" or a package subpath like "my-plugins/grid") whose default export is the Plugin.
A local/external plugin kept but toggled off — [specifier, false] (the spec survives the toggle; the Babel/PostCSS tuple form).
